name: Dakar (Senegal)
description: A white field charged with the arms of Dakar — a shield showing the Mamelles lighthouse, pirogues and a tamarind tree — above the words 'VILLE DE DAKAR'.
history: The arms were chosen through a competition in 1955: the Mamelles lighthouse of 1863, square-sailed pirogues, a tamarind (Wolof 'dakhar', the origin of the city's name) and chevrons for the Mamelles hills. The flag bearing them was reported in 2017; its adoption date is not recorded.

features.role: arms of Dakar with lighthouse, pirogues and tamarind
